interrupted_run.stale_artifact_correction: The 2026-10-22 startup-issues JSON was initially mistaken for current evidence. Current opportunity IDs are already account-scoped; no new identity defect or generator change. Existing scope tests are reexecuted.
interrupted_run.qualification: No complete recovery pass inferred. Six recorded failures are native thread-start errors; the exact failed pytest child alone was interrupted before its fixture was cleanly stopped/removed.
interrupted_run.counting_note: Interrupted pytest emitted one testcase without an outcome tag; it is not counted as a completed pass.

fault_control_pairs.scope: Actual RiskAuthority, native MT5/ctrader parsers, current snapshots, actual EA function bodies and owner readback. Error/skip-only mutant failures do not count.

api_storage_audit.limits: Python audit events only; existing fd writes, native-library raw I/O and external processes are not an OS sandbox. Git state is checked separately.
